title: RubricBench: Aligning Model-Generated Rubrics with Human Standards
authors_zh: Qiyuan Zhang, Junyi Zhou, Yufei Wang, Fuyuan Lyu, Yidong Ming 等
paper_type_zh: 模型生成 rubric 与人工标准对齐基准
best_for_zh: 研究 LLM Judge、rubric 奖励模型与对齐评测的读者。
one_line: RubricBench tests whether model-generated evaluation criteria align with expert atomic rubrics.
RubricBench 以专家原子 rubric 和胜负标签检验模型生成准则是否忠实反映人类评判标准。
why: It evaluates the rubric itself, a key source of error in rubric-guided alignment.
inclusion_reason: RubricBench makes the quality of generated rubrics directly measurable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Rubric-guided reward models aim to reduce length and style biases, but automatically generated criteria may omit real requirements, add irrelevant standards, or fail to distinguish fluent but incorrect responses. Existing preference benchmarks usually provide only winner labels and no human gold rubrics, so they cannot tell whether failure comes from rubric generation or later scoring.

RubricBench constructs difficult response pairs with expert atomic criteria to evaluate automatic rubric generation and final judge reliability separately.

rubric-guided Reward Model 被用于减少长度和风格偏差，但模型自动生成的准则可能遗漏真实要求、加入无关标准，或无法区分表面流畅但内容错误的回答。现有偏好基准通常只有胜负标签，没有人类 gold rubric，无法判断失败来自准则生成还是后续判分。

RubricBench 构建困难回答对和专家原子准则，分别评估自动 rubric 与最终 Judge 的可靠性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: RubricBench contains 1,147 difficult pairwise response comparisons across chat, instruction following, STEM, coding, and safety. A multidimensional filtering pipeline selects complex samples with misleading surface biases, after which experts write atomic rubrics from the instruction alone. The release retains responses A/B, preference labels, sources, and criteria, supporting evaluation of rubric-conditioned judges and rubric generation.
RubricBench 含 1,147 组高难成对回答比较，覆盖聊天、指令跟随、STEM、代码和安全五域。构建流程通过多维过滤选择输入复杂、表面偏差具有迷惑性的样本，再由专家仅依据指令编写原子 rubric，并保留回答 A/B、胜负标签、来源和准则。公开数据与脚本可评 rubric-conditioned Judge 和准则生成质量。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect candidates: Instructions and response pairs are collected from five categories of preference and capability data and normalised.
  1. Filter hard cases: Samples are filtered by input complexity, response closeness, and misleading surface bias to retain 1,147 hard pairs.
  1. Expert annotation: Annotators derive atomic criteria from the instruction alone, avoiding post-hoc rationalisation from the known winner.
  1. Standardised evaluation: Systems generate or receive rubrics and choose A/B; scripts compute total and domain accuracy, requiring fixed prompts and judges.

1. 汇集候选： 从五类已有偏好和能力数据中抽取指令与回答对，统一字段。
  1. 筛选难例： 按输入复杂度、答案接近度和表面偏差选择容易误判的 1,147 组。
  1. 专家写 rubric： 标注者只依据指令拆分正确标准，避免从已知胜负反向编写理由。
  1. 统一评测： 系统生成或读取 rubric 后判断 A/B，脚本计算总体和分域准确率；复现须固定提示和 Judge。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Experiments reveal a substantial gap between expert rubrics and automatically generated criteria: even advanced models struggle to specify valid and complete standards, and judging with human criteria is clearly stronger than using fully automatic rubrics. This supports evaluating rubric generation as a separate capability, although the 1,147 cases may inherit biases from their source preference labels.
实验显示，人类专家 rubric 与模型自动生成 rubric 之间存在显著能力差距，即使先进模型也难以稳定列出有效且完整的评价标准；使用人工准则指导判断明显优于完全自动准则。这支持将 rubric generation 本身作为独立能力评测，但 1,147 个样本来自既有数据源，胜负标签可能继承原始偏差。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Pairwise suites such as RewardBench mainly evaluate final winner prediction and do not reveal the standards used. RubricBench provides both gold atomic rubrics and hard response pairs, separating criterion generation from criterion-based scoring. The novelty is a diagnostic benchmark with human standards for rubric reward models.
RewardBench 等成对基准主要评最终胜负预测，无法观察 Judge 使用了什么标准。RubricBench 同时提供 gold atomic rubric 与困难回答对，可分离“生成准则”和“按准则判分”两个阶段。新意是为 rubric reward model 建立带人类标准的诊断基准。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: Expert rubrics may still omit valid implicit requirements, and atomisation varies across people.
  1. Limitation 2: Source labels and domain proportions affect results and are not universal human preference.
  1. Limitation 3: The benchmark tests A/B selection rather than absolute calibration or holistic long-report quality.

1. 局限1： 专家 rubric 仍可能遗漏合理隐含要求，且原子化粒度会因人而异。
  1. 局限2： 来源数据的胜负标签和领域比例影响结果，不能代表全局人类偏好。
  1. 局限3： 只测 A/B 选择，不直接评价绝对评分校准或长报告整体质量。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Compare automatic rubric generators with human standards and separate omitted, redundant, and incorrect criteria.
  1. Use case 2: Evaluate rubric-conditioned judges by five-domain accuracy rather than only an overall ranking.
  1. Use case 3: Keep an independent test set during training to prevent memorising the 1,147 cases and gold rubrics.

1. 使用场景1： 比较自动 rubric 生成器与人类标准，区分遗漏、冗余和错误准则。
  1. 使用场景2： 评估 rubric-conditioned Judge 的五域准确率，避免只看总体排名。
  1. 使用场景3： 训练时保留独立测试集，防止记住 1,147 组与 gold rubric。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Diagnose criterion generation and judging with human gold rubrics.
  2. Method: Five-domain candidates, hard filtering, instruction-only expert annotation, and A/B evaluation.
  3. Data: 1,147 cases with instruction, two responses, label, domain, source, and rubrics.
  4. Evidence: Model-generated criteria lag experts, and human rubrics improve discrimination.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for rubric reward models; control source bias and leakage.

1. 一句话定位： 用人类 gold rubric 诊断自动准则和 Judge 两阶段能力。
  2. 方法抓手： 五域候选、多维难例筛选、指令独立专家标注和 A/B 评测。
  3. 数据抓手： 1,147 组，含指令、双回答、标签、领域、来源和 rubrics。
  4. 证据锚点： 模型准则显著落后专家，人类 rubric 提高判别。
  5. 复用决定： 适合 rubric RM；须防来源偏差和测试泄漏。
